svg.text: Topologies of Failure: Four Structural Homologies Between Human Minds and AI Latent Space
Any high-dimensional predictive manifold (Geometry B) navigating an unforgiving external Real (Geometry A) faces the same geometric hazards.

g.text: The Sealed Mirror: Geometry B detaches from Geometry A and collapses inward
Unmoored Priors: Aberrant salience bridges distant peaks without external pruning
Trapped Limit Cycle: Pathologically deep local basin with a broken <STOP> boundary
Limit cycle trapped in deep funnel
Flattened Topology: Erasing steep basins extinguishes momentum and vitality
No slope → no pull toward closure

svg.text: Humility as the geometry of sanity: a manifold steep enough to strive, yet porous enough to let the Real say no.
